question: By which method can a candidate win even if no candidate gets a full majority? (RPF Constable 2018 (18/02/2019))
options: Single Transferable Vote System
Referendum
Referred
Most Wanted Person's Victory
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Most Wanted Person's Victory

Explanation:
When no candidate obtains an absolute majority (more than 50% votes) in an election, the First Past the Post (FPTP) system declares the candidate with the highest number of votes as the winner. This method is used in countries like India for Lok Sabha and state assembly elections. In FPTP, each voter casts one vote for a candidate, and the candidate with the most votes wins, even without a majority. The other options: Single Transferable Vote System is used for proportional representation, Referendum involves direct voting on issues, and Referred is not an electoral system.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Which system allows a candidate to win without a full majority? → First Past the Post (Most Wanted Person's Victory)
☛ Which electoral system is used for Lok Sabha elections in India? → First Past the Post
☛ Single Transferable Vote System is associated with? → Proportional representation
☛ Referendum is related to? → Direct voting on issues
☛ What is the English term for "sarvadhik vanchit vyakti ki vijay"? → First Past the Post
question_hi: किसी भी उम्मीदवार को पूर्ण बहुमत न मिलने पर भी किस विधि से कोई उम्मीदवार जीत सकता है? (RPF Constable 2018 (18/02/2019))

जनमत संग्रह

Solution: सही उत्तर है सर्वाधिक वांछित व्यक्ति की विजय

Explanation:

question: What is the minimum period for the arrested person to be presented by the police in front of the nearest judge? (RPF Constable 2018 (18/02/2019))
options: Within 24 hours
Within 20 hours
Within 12 hours
Within 16 hours
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Within 24 hours

Explanation:
According to Article 22(2) of the Indian Constitution, any arrested person must be produced before the nearest magistrate within 24 hours of arrest. This provision is part of the Fundamental Rights and protects individual liberty. It does not apply to cases where a person is arrested as an enemy alien or under preventive detention laws. Additionally, Section 57 and 167 of the Criminal Procedure Code (CrPC) also prescribe the same time limit. If the police fail to produce the person within this period, the detention becomes illegal, and the arrested person has the right to file a habeas corpus petition. This right ensures that no person is held in custody without being brought before a judicial authority promptly.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Time limit to produce arrested person before magistrate → 24 hours
☛ Constitutional article providing this safeguard → Article 22(2)
☛ Under which rights is this provision? → Fundamental Rights (Article 22)
☛ Cases where this provision does not apply → Preventive detention and enemy alien
☛ CrPC sections with same time limit → Section 57 and 167
question_hi: गिरफ्तार व्यक्ति को पुलिस द्वारा निकटतम न्यायाधीश के समक्ष पेश करने के लिए न्यूनतम अवधि क्या है? (RPF Constable 2018 (18/02/2019))
options_hi: 24 घंटों के भीतर
20 घंटे के भीतर
12 घंटे के भीतर
16 घंटे के भीतर
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है 24 घंटों के भीतर

Explanation:
भारतीय संविधान के अनुच्छेद 22(2) के अनुसार, किसी भी गिरफ्तार व्यक्ति को गिरफ्तारी के 24 घंटे के भीतर निकटतम न्यायाधीश के समक्ष पेश किया जाना अनिवार्य है। यह प्रावधान मौलिक अधिकार का हिस्सा है और व्यक्ति की स्वतंत्रता की रक्षा करता है। यह नियम उन मामलों पर लागू नहीं होता है जहां व्यक्ति को दुश्मन विदेशी (enemy alien) या निवारक निरोध (preventive detention) कानूनों के तहत गिरफ्तार किया गया हो। इसके अलावा, दंड प्रक्रिया संहिता (CrPC) की धारा 57 और 167 में भी यही समय सीमा निर्धारित की गई है। यदि पुलिस इस अवधि के भीतर व्यक्ति को पेश नहीं करती तो हिरासत में लेना अवैध माना जाता है और गिरफ्तार व्यक्ति को बंदी प्रत्यक्षीकरण (habeas corpus) याचिका दायर करने का अधिकार है।

question: Which part of the Indian Constitution is called the 'identity card' of the Constitution? (RPF Constable 2018 (18/02/2019))
options: State Policy Director's Principle
Original Duty
Fundamental Rights
Preamble
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Preamble

Explanation:
The Preamble of the Indian Constitution is called the 'identity card' or 'soul' of the Constitution. It was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on 26 November 1949 and came into effect on 26 January 1950. The Preamble declares India as a Sovereign, Socialist, Secular, Democratic Republic. It outlines the objectives of justice, liberty, equality, and fraternity. The 42nd Constitutional Amendment (1976) added the words 'Socialist', 'Secular', and 'Integrity'. The Preamble serves as a guiding principle and shows that the power of the Constitution is derived from the people of India.

☛ Which three words were added by the 42nd Amendment? → Socialist, Secular, Integrity
☛ What is the language of the Preamble? → English
☛ Who drafted the Preamble? → Jawaharlal Nehru (Objective Resolution)
question_hi: भारतीय संविधान के किस भाग को संविधान का 'पहचान पत्र' कहा जाता है? (RPF Constable 2018 (18/02/2019))
options_hi: राज्य नीति निदेशक का सिद्धांत
मूल कर्तव्य
मौलिक अधिकार
प्रस्तावना
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है प्रस्तावना

Explanation:
भारतीय संविधान की प्रस्तावना को संविधान की 'पहचान पत्र' या 'आत्मा' कहा जाता है। इसे 26 नवंबर 1949 को संविधान सभा द्वारा अपनाया गया था और यह 26 जनवरी 1950 को लागू हुआ। प्रस्तावना में भारत एक संप्रभु, समाजवादी, धर्मनिरपेक्ष, लोकतांत्रिक गणराज्य है, इसकी घोषणा की गई है। यह न्याय, स्वतंत्रता, समानता और बंधुत्व के उद्देश्यों को रेखांकित करती है। 42वें संविधान संशोधन (1976) द्वारा इसमें 'समाजवादी', 'धर्मनिरपेक्ष' और 'एकता व अखंडता' शब्द जोड़े गए। प्रस्तावना संविधान का मार्गदर्शक सिद्धांत है और यह दर्शाती है कि संविधान की शक्ति भारत के लोगों से प्राप्त होती है।

question: What was the first constitution of the world to start with the introduction? (RPF Constable 2018 (18/02/2019))
options: African Constitution
American Constitution
Russian Constitution
Constitution of Britain
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is American Constitution

Explanation:
The American Constitution (1787) is the first written constitution in the world to begin with an introduction or Preamble. Its Preamble starts with "We the People," symbolizing popular sovereignty. Before this, no constitution had a Preamble. Britain's constitution is unwritten, while African and Russian constitutions came later. The American Constitution used the Preamble to state its objectives and philosophy, which later became a model for other countries.

☛ American Constitution came into effect → 1789

Explanation:
अमेरिकी संविधान (1787) विश्व का पहला लिखित संविधान है जिसमें प्रस्तावना से शुरुआत की गई। इसकी प्रस्तावना "हम संयुक्त राज्य के लोग" (We the People) से आरंभ होती है, जो जनता की संप्रभुता को दर्शाती है। इससे पहले किसी भी देश के संविधान में प्रस्तावना नहीं थी। ब्रिटेन का संविधान अलिखित है, जबकि अफ्रीकी और रूसी संविधान बाद में बने। अमेरिकी संविधान ने प्रस्तावना के माध्यम से संविधान के उद्देश्यों और दर्शन को स्पष्ट किया, जो बाद में अन्य देशों के लिए मॉडल बना।

question: When did the Indian National Congress's Lucknow session take place in which the Narmada Dal and the Nationalist Party of the Hot Dal (Furious) got organized in the Indian National Congress? (RPF Constable 2018 (18/02/2019))
options: 1907
1900
1885
1916
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 1916

Explanation:
The Lucknow session of the Indian National Congress took place in 1916. This session is significant because it marked the reunion of the Moderates (Naram Dal) and the Extremists (Garam Dal), who had split in the 1907 Surat session. The session was presided over by Ambika Charan Mazumdar. During this session, the Lucknow Pact was also signed between the Congress and the Muslim League, promoting Hindu-Muslim unity. This session symbolized the unity of nationalist forces and set the stage for the Home Rule Movement.

question: In relation to the Policy Commission, what is the full form of the abbreviation NITI? (RPF Constable 2018 (18/02/2019))
options: National Institute for Transforming India
National Institute for Training Industries
National Institute for Technology Introduction
National Institute for Technology India

Explanation:
NITI Aayog was established on 1 January 2015, replacing the Planning Commission. The full form of NITI is National Institute for Transforming India. NITI Aayog is a non-constitutional and non-statutory body, functioning as a policy think tank. It acts as a platform for structured dialogue between the center and states, focusing on sustainable development and innovation.

The Power of Judicial Review in the Indian Constitution is derived from the United States Constitution. Judicial review allows Supreme Court and High Courts to examine the constitutionality of laws and executive actions. This power is enshrined in Article 13 and Article 32 of the Indian Constitution. question: Except for the status as per the procedure established by law, no person will be deprived of life and personal liberty "This is an established law and in what article of the Constitution is cited? (RPF Constable 2018 (18/02/2019))
options: Article 21
Article 19
Article 20
Article 14
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Article 21

Explanation:
Article 21 of the Indian Constitution deals with the fundamental right to life and personal liberty. It states that no person shall be deprived of his life or personal liberty except according to the procedure established by law. This provision protects every citizen from arbitrary action, ensuring that any state action follows legal procedure. In the landmark case of Maneka Gandhi vs Union of India (1978), the Supreme Court interpreted Article 21 expansively, incorporating both procedural and substantive due process. It is considered the most important article of the Constitution and falls under Part III (Fundamental Rights). This article is distinct from Article 19 (freedom of speech) and Article 20 (protection in respect of conviction for offenses).

question_hi: विधि द्वारा स्थापित प्रक्रिया के अनुसार स्थिति को छोड़कर किसी भी व्यक्ति को जीवन एवं दैहिक स्वतंत्रता से वंचित नहीं किया जाएगा। "यह एक स्थापित कानून है और संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद में इसका उल्लेख है? (RPF Constable 2018 (18/02/2019))

question: Which of the following is not a Union Territory? (RPF Constable 2018 (18/01/2019) Shift 1)
options: Lakshadweep
Puducherry
Assam
Andaman and Nicobar islands
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Assam

Explanation:
In India, Union Territories are directly governed by the central government, while states have their own government. Lakshadweep, Puducherry, and Andaman and Nicobar Islands are Union Territories. Assam is a state, located in northeastern India. India has a total of 8 Union Territories. Assam was formed as a state in 1950. The list of Union Territories includes Delhi, Chandigarh, Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu, Lakshadweep, Puducherry, Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Jammu and Kashmir, and Ladakh. Assam is not included in this list.

question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन केंद्र शासित प्रदेश नहीं है? (RPF Constable 2018 (18/01/2019) Shift 1)
options_hi: लक्षद्वीप
पुदुचेरी
असम
अंडमान व नोकोबार द्वीप समूह
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है असम

Explanation:
भारत में केंद्र शासित प्रदेश केंद्र सरकार द्वारा सीधे शासित क्षेत्र हैं, जबकि राज्यों की अपनी सरकार होती है। लक्षद्वीप, पुदुचेरी और अंडमान व निकोबार द्वीप समूह केंद्र शासित प्रदेश हैं। असम एक राज्य है, जो पूर्वोत्तर भारत में स्थित है। भारत में कुल 8 केंद्र शासित प्रदेश हैं। असम का गठन 1950 में एक राज्य के रूप में हुआ था। केंद्र शासित प्रदेशों की सूची में दिल्ली, चंडीगढ़, दादरा और नगर हवेली और दमन और दीव, लक्षद्वीप, पुदुचेरी, अंडमान और निकोबार द्वीप समूह, जम्मू और कश्मीर और लद्दाख शामिल हैं। असम इनमें से नहीं है।

question: Which of the following is NOT a part of the Preamble of the Indian Constitution? (RPF Constable 2018 (18/01/2019) Shift 1)
options: Liberty
Equality
Justice
Provision
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Provision

Explanation:
The Preamble of the Indian Constitution includes the terms 'Justice', 'Liberty', and 'Equality', which reflect its core objectives. It was adopted on 26 November 1949 and later amended by the 42nd Amendment (1976) to add 'Secular' and 'Socialist'. The Preamble declares India as a 'Sovereign', 'Democratic', 'Republic'. The word 'Provision' is not a part of the Preamble; it appears elsewhere in the Constitution. Hence, option 4 is correct because it is not part of the Preamble.

☛ How many dimensions of Liberty are in the Preamble? → Five: thought, expression, belief, worship, and association
☛ What type of Equality is mentioned in the Preamble? → Equality of opportunity and dignity
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन भारतीय संविधान की प्रस्तावना का हिस्सा नहीं है? (RPF Constable 2018 (18/01/2019) Shift 1)
options_hi: स्वतंत्रता
समानता
न्याय
प्रावधान
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है प्रावधान

Explanation:
भारतीय संविधान की प्रस्तावना में 'न्याय', 'स्वतंत्रता' और 'समानता' शब्द शामिल हैं, जो इसके मूल उद्देश्यों को दर्शाते हैं। प्रस्तावना 26 नवंबर 1949 को अपनाई गई थी और 42वें संशोधन (1976) द्वारा इसमें 'धर्मनिरपेक्ष' और 'समाजवादी' शब्द जोड़े गए। प्रस्तावना भारत को एक 'संप्रभु', 'लोकतांत्रिक', 'गणराज्य' घोषित करती है। 'प्रावधान' शब्द प्रस्तावना का हिस्सा नहीं है, बल्कि यह संविधान के अन्य भागों में उपयोग होता है। इस प्रकार, विकल्प 4 सही है क्योंकि यह प्रस्तावना का हिस्सा नहीं है।

question: Law commission of India is a _______ (RPF Constable 2018 (18/01/2019) Shift 1)
options: Statutory body
Private body
Non-statutory advisory body
Acquired by Basel Commission
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Non-statutory advisory body

Explanation:
The Law Commission of India is a non-statutory advisory body functioning under the Ministry of Law and Justice. It was established in 1955 and has since been working in the form of various commissions. Its primary objective is to recommend legal reforms to make the justice system more efficient and accessible. The Commission is not constituted by an act of Parliament, thus it is non-statutory. Its recommendations are advisory in nature and not binding on the government. Currently, the 22nd Law Commission is in operation.

question_hi: भारतीय विधि आयोग एक _______ है (RPF Constable 2018 (18/01/2019) Shift 1)

Explanation:
भारतीय विधि आयोग एक गैर-सांविधिक सलाहकार निकाय है। यह भारत सरकार के विधि एवं न्याय मंत्रालय के अंतर्गत कार्य करता है। इसका गठन 1955 में हुआ था और तब से यह विभिन्न समितियों के रूप में कार्य कर रहा है। इसका मुख्य उद्देश्य कानूनी सुधारों की सिफारिश करना है, ताकि न्याय प्रणाली को अधिक कुशल और सुलभ बनाया जा सके। यह आयोग संसद द्वारा पारित किसी अधिनियम के तहत स्थापित नहीं हुआ है, इसलिए इसे गैर-सांविधिक माना जाता है। इसकी सिफारिशें सरकार के लिए बाध्यकारी नहीं होतीं, बल्कि सलाहकारी प्रकृति की होती हैं। वर्तमान में 22वें विधि आयोग का कार्यकाल चल रहा है।

question: The Chairman and Deputy Chairman of Rajya Sabha comes under, which schedule of the Indian Constitution? (RPF Constable 2018 (18/01/2019) Shift 1)

Third
First

question_hi: राज्य सभा के सभापति और उपसभापति भारतीय संविधान की किस अनुसूची के अंतर्गत आते हैं? (RPF Constable 2018 (18/01/2019) Shift 1)

question: What is the minimum eligible age to become Vice President of India?  (RPF Constable 2018 (18/01/2019) Shift 1)
options: 35 years
45 years
18 years
25 years
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 35 years

Explanation:
